responsibility: Covers the responsibilities of the module files. compiler/rustc_type_ir/src/ty_kind/closure.rs: Defines the type-ir representations and accessors for closure and coroutine generic arguments, including how parent generics, callable/signature metadata, captured upvars, and coroutine-specific components are packed, split, and exposed.
